analysis.unit: case; per-case mean over replicates of (superpowers - superpowers+ElevenPowers)
co_primary: earlier groups lost (passed at the previous graded stage, not passed now), summed over stages
stale documented facts at the end of each stage, summed over stages
analysis.test: two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank over cases (eval.multistage_power.exact_signed_rank); zero differences dropped and counted; Holm across the two co-primaries
analysis.comparable: a conversation counts only if every stage was attempted and graded; others stay in the scheduled denominator, reported missing, never zero
analysis.layout: chosen after the pilot from results/multistage/power.json: the largest affordable layout with power >= 0.8 at ratio 0.5 at the pilot arm-A rate, else the cheapest, run as descriptive
analysis.pilot_runs: excluded from the analysis; no case is dropped or replaced on its pilot result
